member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.ByteSize.ToString(System.String)
member.summary: Convert value to string
member.param:
Allowed formats:
G: Find the best unit (B, kB, MB, GB, etc.), and use G format for the value
G2: Find the best unit (B, kB, MB, GB, etc.), and use F2 format for the value
Gi: Find the best unit (B, kiB, MiB, GiB, etc.), and use G format for the value
Gi2: Find the best unit (B, kiB, MiB, GiB, etc.), and use F2 format for the value
F, F2, Fi, Fi2: Synonyms of G, G2, Gi, Gi2
B, kB, kiB, MB, MiB, GB, GiB, TB, TiB, PB, PiB, EB, EiB: Use the provided unit, and use G format for the value. If a number is provided (e.g. kB3), it use Fn (e.g. F3) format to convert the value to string.
member.exception: The provided format is not valid
